read.title: Welcome to the Global Sales Team
read.text:
Hi Jisoo,

Welcome aboard! We are excited to have you join the Global Sales Team at Lumina Cosmetics.

Your first week will focus on orientation and training. On Monday morning, HR will explain company policies and help you set up your laptop and email account. In the afternoon, you will meet Daniel, who will be your mentor for the next three months.

From Tuesday to Thursday, please familiarize yourself with our main product lines and the export process. Daniel will also invite you to our weekly team meeting so you can see how we work with overseas partners.

On Friday, we will have a short check-in to see how you are doing. We know it takes time to get up to speed, so don't worry about learning everything at once.

If you need anything, don't hesitate to reach out.

Best regards,
Sarah Kim
Team Leader
qs: 월요일 오전에 인사팀이 해 주는 일은?

write.en: As a mentor, write a short email welcoming a new team member, explaining their first-day schedule and inviting them to ask questions.
write.model:
Hi Jiwon,

Welcome aboard! I'm Minsu, and I'll be your mentor for the next few months.

On your first day, you'll start with orientation at 9 a.m. After lunch, I'll introduce you to the team and show you our main tools. It may take a few weeks to get up to speed, so please take your time.

If you have any questions, don't hesitate to reach out.

See you on Monday,
Minsu
